description: Plot pipeline control comparison: IRG-2 vs IRG-1 vs PMK-1 best Foldseek E-values
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

dat=pd.DataFrame([
  dict(query='IRG-2 (O16224)\n278 aa', db='PDB100',          E=3.268,     cov=0.14, note='DnaK/GrpE 4ani_D, 11% id'),
  dict(query='IRG-2 (O16224)\n278 aa', db='CATH50',          E=1.666,     cov=0.21, note='3.30.420.10, 13% id'),
  dict(query='IRG-2 (O16224)\n278 aa', db='AFDB/Swiss-Prot', E=4.223,     cov=0.20, note='MJ0365, 9% id'),
  dict(query='IRG-1 (O16327)\n212 aa', db='PDB100',          E=1.904e-8,  cov=0.97, note='8bau_A NADAR+ADP-ribose, 28% id'),
  dict(query='IRG-1 (O16327)\n212 aa', db='CATH50',          E=5.444e-15, cov=0.91, note='1.10.357.40 YbiA-like'),
  dict(query='IRG-1 (O16327)\n212 aa', db='AFDB/Swiss-Prot', E=1.331e-7,  cov=0.88, note='N-glycosidase YbiA P30176, 26% id'),
  dict(query='PMK-1 (Q17446)\n377 aa', db='PDB100',          E=5.140e-47, cov=0.90, note='1bl6_A p38 MAPK, 67% id'),
  dict(query='PMK-1 (Q17446)\n377 aa', db='CATH50',          E=1.659e-39, cov=0.79, note='1.10.510.10 kinase'),
  dict(query='PMK-1 (Q17446)\n377 aa', db='AFDB/Swiss-Prot', E=6.862e-50, cov=0.93, note='MAPK14, 65% id'),
])
dat['negLog10E']=-np.log10(dat.E)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.6))
qs=list(dat['query'].unique()); dbs=['PDB100','CATH50','AFDB/Swiss-Prot']
w=0.26; cols={'PDB100':'#2c5f8a','CATH50':'#4e9c6b','AFDB/Swiss-Prot':'#c99a2e'}
for i,db in enumerate(dbs):
    s=dat[dat.db==db].set_index('query').loc[qs]
    xp=np.arange(len(qs))+(i-1)*w
    ax.bar(xp, s['negLog10E'].values, w, color=cols[db], label=db)
    for x,v,c in zip(xp, s['negLog10E'].values, s['cov'].values):
        ax.text(x, max(v,0)+1.0, f"cov {c:.0%}", ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=90)
ax.axhline(0, color='k', lw=.8)
ax.axhline(3, color='#b03a2e', ls='--', lw=1.2)
ax.text(2.48, 4.0, 'E = 1e-3', color='#b03a2e', fontsize=8.5, ha='right')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(qs))); ax.set_xticklabels(qs, fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('-log10 (best E-value), self-hits and nematode paralogs excluded')
ax.set_title('Same Foldseek pipeline, three C. elegans queries\nIRG-2 returns nothing; the co-regulated immune gene irg-1 recovers its curated NADAR/YbiA fold', fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

dat.to_csv("/agent/jobs/29937715-f3de-4c80-a203-a9ca6414aa2d/provenance/foldseek_positive_controls.csv", index=False)
print(dat[['query','db','E','cov','note']].to_string(index=False))
